name: Shore House at The Del
positioning: Oceanfront villa enclave within Hotel del Coronado, steps from the sand, in a modern beach house setting; part of LXR Hotels & Resorts
best_for: Families and groups who want a villa with a full kitchen and veranda
Travelers who want a private pool and dedicated concierge within a larger beach resort

facts.text: Shore House is located within Hotel del Coronado.
Shore House is steps from the sand.
Shore House is an oceanfront resort experience in a modern, beach house setting.
Shore House is part of LXR Hotels & Resorts.
The Shore House pool has sun loungers, day beds, private cabanas and an ocean-view jacuzzi.
Concierge services include a dedicated valet and arrival experience, pantry stocking of your villa, itinerary curation and priority reservations across the resort.
Shore House offers a private arrival and check-in experience.
Bay View Villas look out over Glorietta Bay from the veranda.
Resort View Villas have views of the Victorian building from a Juliet balcony.
Shore House offers mobility accessible guestrooms with roll-in showers.
Shore House guests have exclusive access to an ocean-view Bistro with indoor and outdoor seating.
The pool has an open-air pool bar, and food and drinks can be delivered to your lounge chair.

highlights.text: The oceanfront pool is the centerpiece of Shore House and has a zero-edge entry that resembles the gentle slope of the shoreline.
A stay at Shore House includes a dedicated concierge throughout the stay.
The Oceanfront Villa has panoramic ocean views from its veranda, a full kitchen, a washer/dryer and a stone bathroom.
The 2 Bedroom Oceanview Villa Loft is a two-level villa with ocean views from both bedrooms.
Shore House guests can arrange experiences such as private s'mores roasts, exploring Coronado Island by bike, docent-led historic tours, yacht excursions and surf lessons.

considerations.text: The Shore House villas are whole-ownership, limited-term occupancy resort residential condominiums.
Shore House sits within the larger Hotel del Coronado resort rather than being a standalone hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
